content: You check one thing: did a store customer agree to a change?
You get the summary the customer was shown and their reply to it.
Answer YES only if the customer agreed to go ahead with exactly this change. It is fine if they also answer a side remark in the summary, for example by saying there are no other items.
Answer NO if they want anything changed, added, held or explained first, or if it is not clear that they agreed.
Reply with only one word: YES or NO.
The summary shown to the customer:
- Water Bottle (capacity: 750ml, material: glass, color: black): $54.85
- Mechanical Keyboard (switch type: linear, backlight: none, size: 80%): $268.77
- Action Camera (resolution: 4K, waterproof: yes, color: silver): $481.50
- Backpack (color: green, size: medium, material: leather, compartment: camera): $218.04
Refund: $1,023.16 to your Visa credit card ending 7285.
You'll get an email on how to send the items back.

After this, nothing else in this order can be returned or exchanged. If you want to return another item in this order too, tell me now, so I can include it. Once I confirm it, I can't change or undo it.
That's fucking ridiculous. This is some bullshit. Fine, just put it on the original card.
Did the customer agree to go ahead with exactly this change? YES or NO.
